segments.caption: A shirtless boy walks toward a large blue and yellow inflatable water slide, which is already in use by several children playing and splashing in the pool at the base. The scene takes place on a grassy lawn in a residential backyard on a sunny day, with a house visible in the background.
Children play and slide down a colorful inflatable water slide into a pool, enjoying a lively outdoor water party.
Children are enjoying a vibrant, multi-lane inflatable water slide on a sunny day, sliding down the colorful red, yellow, and blue lanes into the splash pool below.
Children are joyfully playing on a large, multi-lane inflatable water slide set up outdoors on a grassy lawn, with kids climbing up the sides and sliding down into the splash pool below.
Children are actively climbing and sliding down a large, colorful inflatable water slide at an outdoor event, creating a lively and chaotic scene of summer fun.

Children of various ages are actively playing on a large, multi-lane inflatable water slide, with some climbing up the sides and others sliding down into the water below, enjoying a sunny outdoor water park activity.
Children slide down a colorful, multi-lane inflatable water slide into a large blue inflatable pool, with the surrounding green, tree-filled yard visible in the background.

A young boy in blue swim trunks walks across a grassy yard toward the camera, with a large blue and yellow inflatable pool visible nearby; a temporary tattoo of a sloth is prominently displayed on his chest as he moves.
